world.title: Iran war news LIVE Updates: Iran says US economic sanctions a ‘declaration of war’ on all nations
world.summary: Iran has declared that U.S. economic sanctions represent a "declaration of war" against all nations. President Donald Trump stated that while Iran desires an agreement with the U.S., it is not yet willing to accept the terms he deems necessary. The ongoing tensions highlight the complexities of negotiations between the two countries amid escalating economic pressures.

world.title: Russian strikes kill 6 people in Ukraine, day after shopping complex attack
world.summary: Russian aerial strikes in Ukraine have resulted in at least six fatalities and 26 injuries. This attack follows a previous strike on a shopping complex. Concurrently, a Ukrainian drone targeted a home in southern Russia, leading to the deaths of two children and injuries to their parents, according to officials from both Ukraine and Russia.

world.title: Chinese J-16 fighters arrive in Egypt ahead of Eagles of Civilisation 2026 joint drill
world.summary: Chinese J-16 fighters have arrived in Egypt for the Eagles of Civilisation 2026 joint military exercise. This marks their first deployment in Africa. The multi-role PLA fighters traveled 6,000 kilometers (3,700 miles) in nine hours, requiring mid-air refueling during the journey. The exercise aims to enhance military cooperation between China and Egypt.

business.title: SEBI proposing framework to scrap duplicate fines across exchanges for same violation
business.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is proposing a framework to eliminate duplicate fines imposed on listed companies by multiple stock exchanges for the same compliance violation. This initiative aims to streamline the penalty process and reduce the financial burden on companies facing identical penalties from different exchanges, thereby enhancing regulatory efficiency and fairness in the market.

business.title: The next export story: A $50 billion prize India can't afford to miss
business.summary: India's telecom equipment exports are currently between $0.6-1 billion annually, significantly lower than imports, which are four to five times higher. A recent NITI Aayog assessment suggests that India has the potential to address this imbalance and could develop into a $50 billion telecom equipment export hub by 2035, presenting a significant economic opportunity.

business.title: Sharjah landmark Ansar Mall set to close; new stores planned in Abu Dhabi, Dubai
business.summary: Ansar Mall, a notable landmark on Ittihad Road between Dubai and Sharjah, is set to close its three branches, although no specific closing date has been announced. Signs have been posted to inform shoppers of the impending closures. Meanwhile, plans are underway to open new stores in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, expanding the brand's presence in the region.

technology.title: These 30+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (August 24-28)
technology.summary: Over 30 games are set to release on Xbox from August 24-28, including three titles for Xbox Game Pass. Notable upcoming releases include "Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2," "Metal Gear Solid 4," and "Star Wars Zero Company." The roundup highlights a variety of genres and anticipated titles, providing gamers with numerous options for their gaming experience in the coming week.

technology.title: "We couldn’t afford to spend days studying the code"
technology.summary: Microsoft's Raymond Chen revealed that 3D Pinball, included in Windows since 1995, was last featured in Windows XP. Its absence in Windows Vista was not due to legal issues, as previously thought, but rather the high costs associated with studying the code and licensing complications. Consequently, the game cannot officially return to future Windows versions.

technology.title: PlayStation Share of the Week Top 6 Katana Shots Revealed
technology.summary: PlayStation has unveiled its latest Share of the Week, showcasing six impressive katana-themed Photo Mode captures from popular games including Ghost of Yōtei and Cyberpunk 2077. This initiative encourages players to share their best katana moments, highlighting the weapon's significance in gaming culture. The selected images reflect the creativity and skill of the PlayStation community.

sports.title: After Joe Root, Ben Stokes calls ECB decision 'shambolic' over Headingley’s 2027 Ashes exclusion
sports.summary: Former England Test captain Ben Stokes criticized the England and Wales Cricket Board's decision to exclude Headingley from the 2027 men's Ashes schedule, labeling it "shambolic." Stokes's remarks follow similar sentiments expressed by Joe Root regarding the omission. The decision has sparked controversy among players and fans, highlighting concerns over the selection of venues for significant cricket events.

sports.title: Usain Bolt’s 100m record broken at World Humanoid Robot Games
sports.summary: A humanoid robot named Lightning, developed by Chinese smartphone maker Honor, broke Usain Bolt's 100m world record at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing. The robot achieved a speed of 14.5 metres per second, completing the distance in 9.32 seconds, according to China's state media. This marks a significant technological achievement in robotics and speed.

sports.title: Kuldeep Yadav or Saransh Jain? The subplot thickens as Colombo braces for a different script
sports.summary: In Colombo, speculation surrounds Kuldeep Yadav's participation as he missed a practice session, raising questions about his fitness. Team India head coach Gautam Gambhir was seen encouraging Saransh Jain after his practice, hinting at potential changes in the lineup. The situation adds intrigue to the upcoming match, with fans eager to see which player will take the field.

health.title: Medanta launches new Oral Cancer Awareness campaign
health.summary: Medanta has launched an oral cancer awareness campaign titled ‘Taalo Mat Pehchaano’ in India. The initiative aims to educate the public on recognizing early signs of oral cancer, such as non-healing sores, unusual mouth patches, or persistent wounds. The campaign emphasizes the importance of timely medical consultation to improve outcomes and increase awareness of this serious health issue.

health.title: Menopause is not just hot flashes: Experts explain what really happens
health.summary: At the India Today Women's Summit, experts highlighted that menopause involves more than just hot flashes. They emphasized the importance of understanding menopause symptoms, associated health risks, and available treatment options. Doctors encouraged women to seek timely medical advice and to break the stigma surrounding menopause, advocating for a more informed and proactive approach to women's health during this phase.

science.title: Trees are connected by fungal threads beneath the soil, trading carbon and chemical signals in ways scientists are still arguing over — including whether a dying tree can pass part of itself into the
science.summary: Trees may exchange resources and information through underground fungal networks, a phenomenon still debated among scientists. Research from British Columbia shows that a birch seedling can transfer a rare carbon form to a nearby fir tree within nine days. This discovery, published in Nature in 1997, highlights the complexity of interactions among trees, including potential resource sharing and communication.

science.title: Researchers turned data from roughly 1,200 Starlink satellites into a giant scanner for Earth’s upper atmosphere, mapping a hard-to-observe region around 500 kilometres above the planet
science.summary: Researchers utilized data from approximately 1,200 Starlink satellites to create a comprehensive scanner for Earth's upper atmosphere. This innovative approach enables the mapping of a challenging-to-observe region located around 500 kilometers above the planet. The study highlights the potential of satellite networks, originally intended for internet connectivity, to contribute significantly to atmospheric science and research.

science.title: Meet 11-year-old Atharv Sood, the Indian student credited with three preliminary asteroid detections; How a birthday telescope sparked his journey into real space science
science.summary: Eleven-year-old Atharv Sood from India has made headlines for detecting three preliminary asteroids. His interest in astronomy began with a birthday telescope, leading him to observe celestial bodies like the Moon and Jupiter. Atharv's journey reflects a growing passion for space science, showcasing how curiosity can inspire young minds to explore the universe beyond Earth.

entertainment.title: Govinda SPOTTED outside Mumbai hospital amid Sunita Ahuja's second marriage claims, says, 'Theek hoon'
entertainment.summary: Govinda was seen outside a hospital in Mumbai, coinciding with claims regarding his estranged wife Sunita Ahuja's second marriage. The actor addressed concerns about his well-being, stating, "Theek hoon," which translates to "I am fine." This sighting highlights the ongoing marital issues between the couple, drawing public attention amid the rumors surrounding their relationship.

entertainment.title: I am sole earner: Microsoft lays off employee in Hyderabad, saying you are too young
entertainment.summary: A Microsoft engineer in Hyderabad lost his job during recent layoffs and shared his experience on Reddit. He emphasized his family's financial reliance on him and expressed concern about finding a new role. The engineer, with approximately three years of experience, reported that his manager cited his youth as a factor in the decision to terminate his employment.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Tomorrow, August 23, 2026: Something that begins casually may develop into a more meaningful possibility
entertainment.summary: On August 23, 2026, horoscopes suggest that casual beginnings may evolve into significant opportunities. Prioritizing family, finances, and long-term stability is advised. Professional or financial advancements could enhance feelings of security. Individuals are encouraged to make decisions that favor future benefits over immediate gains. Recognition may also be forthcoming for some, highlighting the importance of patience and strategic planning.
